semiconductor_relevance: High — XYC-TEK provides advanced equipment for wafer fabrication and packaging processes, which are critical stages in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: XYC-TEK Intelligent Equipment (Wuxi) Co., Ltd. specializes in the development and manufacturing of advanced semiconductor equipment. Their offerings include precision tools and systems aimed at enhancing manufacturing efficiency and yield in semiconductor production, particularly in wafer fabrication and packaging processes.

regional_presence.Malaysia: Recently expanded operations with a new branch in Penang to better serve customers in the region.
